### GSE181294 does not have the condition column, age or any bGleason columns

```{r}
library(GEOquery)
#enter in GSE141445
#read in the whole count matrices and meta data

gse_181294 <- getGEO("GSE181294", GSEMatrix = TRUE)
#divide the ExpressionSet into the expression matrix and meta data

gse_181294 <- gse_181294[[1]]

#expression matrix

expr_181294 <- exprs(gse_181294)

#meta-data
meta_181294 <- pData(gse_181294)

#showing first five rows of the meta-data and the expression samples
head(expr_181294, n = 5)
head(meta_181294, n = 5)
#download the data into the data directory
getGEOSuppFiles("GSE181294")

# editing inital  metaData
colnames(meta_181294)
meta_181294 <- meta_181294 %>% 
  select(c(title, geo_accession, "age:ch1", "condition:ch1", "gleason:ch1")) %>%
  mutate(`gleason:ch1` = case_when(
    "NA" == `gleason:ch1` ~ NA_character_,
    str_detect(`gleason:ch1`, "=") ~ gsub("=.*$", "", `gleason:ch1`))) %>%
  mutate(`gleason:ch1` = trimws(`gleason:ch1`))

#before renaming
meta_181294

#renaming columns
colnames(meta_181294)[colnames(meta_181294) == "gleason:ch1"] <- "bGleason"
colnames(meta_181294)[colnames(meta_181294) == "condition:ch1"] <- "condition"
colnames(meta_181294)[colnames(meta_181294) == "age:ch1"] <- "Age"

meta_181294
```

```{r}
condition_markers <- c(unique(meta_181294$condition))
condition_label_replacements <- c("healthy", "norm_adj", "tumor_core")

replacement <- setNames(condition_label_replacements, condition_markers)

meta_181294 <- meta_181294  %>%
  mutate(condition = replacement[condition])
```

```{r}

#extractig the cell names
cell_names <-  rownames(gse181294.obj@meta.data)
cell_names[1:10]
#seperating the cell_names from the GSMXXXXX sample title
#sample_title <- sub("\\..*", "", cell_names)
barcodes <- sub("^[^.]*\\.","", cell_names)

sample_title <- str_extract(barcodes, "^[^_]*_") %>% 
  str_remove("_") %>%   
  str_replace_all("\\.", "-")



if(!identical(barcodes, rownames(gse181294.obj@meta.data))){ 
  rownames(gse181294.obj@meta.data) <- barcodes 
}

gse181294.obj@meta.data$title <- sample_title
gse181294.obj@meta.data


#joining meta.data with clinical data
gse181294.obj@meta.data <- left_join(gse181294.obj@meta.data, meta_181294, by = "title")

saveRDS(gse181294.obj, "./post_qc_rds_files/gse181294.rds")
```
